meaning: for the most part; mostly

senses.en: for the most part; mostly

note: Spoken often as dàdōu; this entry is read dàdū.

examples.zh: 周末公园里的人大都是老人和孩子。
examples.en: On weekends, most people in the park are old people and children.

examples.zh: 我的同事大都住得离公司很远。
examples.en: Most of my colleagues live far from the company.

examples.zh: 这家店的菜大都不辣，你放心吃吧。
examples.en: Most dishes here aren't spicy, so go ahead and eat.

meaning: attachment (to an email); appendix to a document

senses.en: attachment (to an email); appendix to a document

examples.zh: 请看邮件的附件，里面有合同。
examples.en: Please look at the email attachment; the contract is in it.

examples.zh: 我忘了加附件，现在重新发一遍。
examples.en: I forgot to add the attachment, so I'll send it again now.

examples.zh: 你打不开这个附件吗？我再发一个给你。
examples.en: Can't you open this attachment? I'll send you another one.

meaning: to call on (people) to do something; a public call

senses.en: to call on (people) to do something; a public call

note: Usually an authority or organization calling on the public to act.

examples.zh: 学校号召大家节约用水。
examples.en: The school calls on everyone to save water.

examples.zh: 医院号召老人每年做一次检查。
examples.en: The hospital calls on older people to get a checkup every year.

examples.zh: 他一听到公司的号召，就报名参加了。
examples.en: As soon as he heard the company's call, he signed up.

meaning: original; existing before

senses.en: original; existing before

note: Used before a noun: 原有的 + noun.

examples.zh: 新经理保留了原有的办法。
examples.en: The new manager kept the existing method.

examples.zh: 装修后，原有的家具都不要了。
examples.en: After the renovation, we don't want any of the original furniture.

examples.zh: 地铁开了以后，原有的路线会变吗？
examples.en: After the subway opens, will the existing bus routes change?

meaning: to have a bumper harvest; a bumper harvest

senses.en: to have a bumper harvest; a bumper harvest

examples.zh: 今年雨水多，农民的苹果丰收了。
examples.en: There was a lot of rain this year, and the farmers' apples had a bumper harvest.

examples.zh: 老家的水果今年又丰收了。
examples.en: The fruit back in my hometown had a bumper harvest again this year.

examples.zh: 大家都为这次丰收感到高兴。
examples.en: Everyone is happy about this bumper harvest.

meaning: fossil

senses.en: fossil

examples.zh: 博物馆里有很多古代的化石。
examples.en: The museum has many ancient fossils.

examples.zh: 这块化石有一亿年了。
examples.en: This fossil is a hundred million years old.

examples.zh: 孩子们在山上发现了一块化石。
examples.en: The children found a fossil on the mountain.

meaning: north and south; north to south

senses.en: north and south; north to south

examples.zh: 中国南北的饮食习惯很不一样。
examples.en: Eating habits in northern and southern China are quite different.

examples.zh: 这条路是南北方向的，很好找。
examples.en: This road runs north to south, so it's easy to find.

examples.zh: 这个湖南北长三公里。
examples.en: This lake is three kilometers long from north to south.

meaning: range or extent of a change

senses.en: range or extent of a change

note: Typical: 变化/上涨/下降 的幅度; 大幅度 = by a large margin.

examples.zh: 今年水果价格上涨的幅度不大。
examples.en: Fruit prices rose only slightly this year.

examples.zh: 医生说，体重下降的幅度太大不好。
examples.en: The doctor says it's not good if weight drops too fast.

examples.zh: 气温变化的幅度有多大？
examples.en: How big is the change in temperature?

meaning: to form a matching set; matching, supporting (facilities)

senses.en: to form a matching set; matching, supporting (facilities)

examples.zh: 这套衣服有配套的帽子。
examples.en: This outfit comes with a matching hat.

examples.zh: 新房子附近的学校和医院都配套好了。
examples.en: The new neighborhood already has its school and hospital in place.

examples.zh: 这双鞋和那件衣服配套吗？
examples.en: Do these shoes go with that outfit?

meaning: personal cultivation; refinement and good manners

senses.en: personal cultivation; refinement and good manners

examples.zh: 他很有修养，说话总是很客气。
examples.en: He is well-bred and always speaks politely.

examples.zh: 读书可以提高一个人的修养。
examples.en: Reading can improve a person's cultivation.

examples.zh: 在公共场所大声打电话，说明缺少修养。
examples.en: Talking loudly on the phone in public shows a lack of manners.

meaning: baijiu, strong Chinese grain liquor

senses.en: baijiu, strong Chinese grain liquor

examples.zh: 他不喝啤酒，只喝白酒。
examples.en: He doesn't drink beer, only baijiu.

examples.zh: 喝了白酒就不能开车。
examples.en: You can't drive after drinking baijiu.

examples.zh: 请问，这家店有卖白酒吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, does this shop sell baijiu?

meaning: strenuous; to find it a strain

senses.en: strenuous; to find it a strain

note: 吃力 is often used after 得: 搬得很吃力.

examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬得很吃力。
examples.en: This box is too heavy; I'm struggling to carry it.

examples.zh: 他听英语新闻有点儿吃力。
examples.en: He finds listening to English news a bit of a strain.

examples.zh: 爬山的时候，你会觉得吃力吗？
examples.en: Do you find it hard going when you climb mountains?

meaning: in a row; one after another

senses.en: in a row; one after another

note: Used before a verb, often with a count or a time span.

examples.zh: 这个星期他接连加班，太累了。
examples.en: He has worked overtime day after day this week and is exhausted.

examples.zh: 接连下了三天雨，衣服一直不干。
examples.en: It rained three days in a row, and the clothes stay damp.

examples.zh: 孩子接连发烧了好几天，带他去看医生吧。
examples.en: The child has had a fever for several days in a row; take him to the doctor.

meaning: runner-up; second place

senses.en: runner-up; second place

examples.zh: 他在羽毛球比赛中得了亚军。
examples.en: He took second place in the badminton competition.

examples.zh: 我们队这次只拿到了亚军。
examples.en: Our team only got second place this time.

examples.zh: 谁是冠军，谁是亚军？
examples.en: Who is the champion and who is the runner-up?

meaning: to manage and bring under control; to govern

senses.en: to manage and bring under control; to govern

note: Typical objects: 污染, 环境, 交通, 城市.

examples.zh: 政府正在治理河水污染。
examples.en: The government is dealing with the river pollution.

examples.zh: 这个城市的空气污染治理得不错。
examples.en: This city has done a decent job controlling air pollution.

examples.zh: 怎样才能治理好交通问题？
examples.en: How can the traffic problem be properly dealt with?

meaning: to host; to organize (an event)

senses.en: to host; to organize (an event)

examples.zh: 这次会议由我们学院主办。
examples.en: This conference is hosted by our college.

examples.zh: 哪个城市主办下一届运动会？
examples.en: Which city will host the next Games?

examples.zh: 这个展览是谁主办的？
examples.en: Who organized this exhibition?

meaning: workday; weekday

senses.en: workday; weekday

examples.zh: 工作日我七点起床，周末睡到九点。
examples.en: On workdays I get up at seven; on weekends I sleep until nine.

examples.zh: 这家银行只在工作日营业。
examples.en: This bank is only open on workdays.

examples.zh: 快递一般三个工作日能到。
examples.en: Express delivery usually arrives within three working days.

meaning: lasting (a set period of time)

senses.en: lasting (a set period of time)

note: Pattern: 为期 + time + 的 + noun.

examples.zh: 我参加了一个为期三天的培训。
examples.en: I took part in a three-day training.

examples.zh: 展览为期一个月，免费参观。
examples.en: The exhibition lasts one month, with free admission.

examples.zh: 这门课为期两周，每天上两小时。
examples.en: This course lasts two weeks, two hours a day.

meaning: bright and vivid (of colors)

senses.en: bright and vivid (of colors)

examples.zh: 她穿了一件颜色很鲜艳的裙子。
examples.en: She wore a dress in a very bright color.

examples.zh: 春天，公园里的花开得很鲜艳。
examples.en: In spring, the flowers in the park bloom in vivid colors.

examples.zh: 我不喜欢太鲜艳的颜色。
examples.en: I don't like colors that are too bright.

meaning: disciplinary action; to discipline

senses.en: disciplinary action; to discipline

note: Given by a school or employer for breaking rules.

examples.zh: 他迟到太多次，被公司给了一个处分。
examples.en: He was late too many times and got a disciplinary warning from the company.

examples.zh: 学校决定处分迟到的学生。
examples.en: The school decided to discipline the students who were late.

examples.zh: 他打架了，受到了处分。
examples.en: He got into a fight and was disciplined.
